services.name: Begin Lessons
services.desc: Weekly private lessons are offered for 30, 45 or 60 minutes and are hosted in-person at FAME Center. Instruction for some instruments available in Spanish! Private lessons are offered for Art, Cello, Clarinet, Coding, Creative Writing, Drum, Flute, Guitar, Piano, Saxophone, Ukulele, Viola, Violin, and Voice. Getting started at FAME is simple: submit the New Student Lesson Inquiry Form, and our Student Services Associate will match you with the right teacher based on your interests and schedule. blurb: FAME Center provides equal access to arts education so kids everywhere have creative tools to uncover their potential and imagine a bright future. We do this through music lessons and art classes for all ages. Early childhood classes, drama and theater, creative writing skills, visual and digital art and music and art therapy are all part of our multi-disciplinary art educational program.
